paragraphs.text: The Kodama of the North Tree is a kami of the Winter Tree of the Jukai on Kamigawa .

The Kodama of the North Tree is the kami of the Winter Tree in the Jukai Forest , one of the Five Trees . It values survival above all else and does not suffer fools lightly. It generally wants to be left alone until provoked after which it becomes a deadly force of nature. Before the Kami War it was rarely seen but during the war, it woke and became like a slumbering angry bear.
